rationale: Create features based on customer behavior, product attributes, and time decay to predict purchases in the next 7 days.

aggregates.name: f_customer_recent_purchases
aggregates.sql: sum(CASE WHEN days_ago BETWEEN 1 AND 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

derived.name: f_product_recent_sales
derived.sql: f_product_purchase_count - sum(CASE WHEN days_ago BETWEEN 7 AND 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
